changes.text: The Spring Fling Event has now ended.
Liquid Nitrogen: Now properly inherits slow enhancements.
Tri-Cannon: This pet can now taunt Raid Tagged targets. Can now proc Containment damage.
Tear Gas: This pseudopet now does damage against held targets. Now takes damage enhancements and sets.
Added safety measure to prevent a bug caused by simultaneous cut scenes triggers.
The Honoree's arrival cut scene mentions 'Damage Neutralizer' specifically to hint to players that he's invincible at first.
Some adjustments to Ruin's room to better communicate that he can't be saved nor fought.
Fixed two missions in Mage-Killer Tatiana's arc where certain bosses would not activate their combat AI at the correct time.
Removed interrupt time from the NPC versions of Trip Mine and Time Bomb.
Fixed a bug that could cause the auction server to return sale history for the wrong item.
Standardized taunt values and removed -Range on Dark Dwarf Alpha mobs.
Standardized taunt values and removed -Range on Cannon Rook mobs.
Cannon Rook's Sprocket companion weapon now mourns upon their Rook's defeat.
Cannon Rook's back key now stops turning on death like other Clockwork.
Assembler Lord's back key now stops turning on death like other Clockwork.
Corrected Benevolab vendor dialog to the now shortened 'Prismatic Aether' salvage name.
Fixed an issue that was preventing queuing for this event with lower level characters.
